values.note: The FS posts a 35-ft maximum; recreation.gov's catalog lists 24 sites at 24-60 ft (mostly 35-38 ft, five pull-throughs), so every site takes a 23-ft rig. The rig must fit the parking spur; no overflow parking. Entrance and exit roads are steep.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/graham-creek-campground ('25 sites - 15 reservable sites and 10 first-come, first-served sites'; 'Sites are available for large RVs, although entrance and exit roads are steep'; 'Max RV size = 35 ft') + recreation.gov campsite catalog (24 sites; Max Vehicle Length 24-60 ft; 5 Pull-Through), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233246 (all 24 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC) + FS page amenities (toilets, potable water only), read 2026-10-28

values.note: The FS lists two composting toilets; recreation.gov calls them vault toilets.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/graham-creek-campground ('Composting Toilet (2)'; 'Potable water is available at this site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233246 ('Vault toilets and drinking water are provided'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: May through September; the FS defers exact dates to recreation.gov, whose 2026 season ran May 8 - September 19.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/graham-creek-campground ('Seasons of Use | May through September. For specific open / closure dates, visit recreation.gov') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233246/rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-08 to 2026-09-19), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 15 sites reservable on recreation.gov (at least 4 days ahead), 10 first-come. recreation.gov sets 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday minimums, marked soft, so they may be relaxed for a same-day booking. 14 nights in any 30.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/graham-creek-campground ('25 sites - 15 reservable sites and 10 first-come, first-served sites') + recreation.gov rules (minWeekendStay 2 soft, minHolidayWeekendStay 3 softAny, maxStay 14 rolling 30 days, reservationCutOff 4), read 2026-10-28

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/graham-creek-campground ('Single Site: $32 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233246/rates (2026 Peak Season STANDARD NONELECTRIC $32), read 2026-10-28

note: San Juan NF (Columbine RD) on the east side of Vallecito Reservoir, via CR 240/CR 501 and FR 603. Hillside sites, some under big trees, some open, a few with lake views, about 100 yd above the high-water line with willows between; campers can walk the closed old boat-ramp spur to the shore (the ramp is permanently closed - launch on the west side after a CPW inspection). Private land adjoins the south side. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 25 sites (15 reservable / 10 FCFS), max RV 35 ft (agency figure), potable water, toilets, no hookups, $32. Added pull-throughs, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday soft minimums, 14-night max, season May-Sept (2026: May 8 - Sept 19). Lakeview stands (sites ~100+ m above the high-water edge behind willows). Pin 81 m from the site centroid. Note trimmed.
flags: Length conflict: FS 'Max RV size = 35 ft' vs recreation.gov catalog lengths up to 60 ft (sites 010/011 60 ft, 020 45 ft, 022 42 ft, nine at 38 ft). Kept the FS 35 ft; all sites take 23 ft either way.
Site count: FS 25 (15 + 10); recreation.gov catalog 24 (no site 024; 15 reservable + 9 first-come).
Missing phone: Columbine Ranger District (970) 884-2512 (FS page; office open Fridays only).
Minimum stays are recreation.gov 'soft' rules (2 weekend, 3 holiday) - recorded as rules; may be relaxed same-day.
FS page showed 'Site Closed' on 2026-10-28 - the season end (recreation.gov 2026 season ended Sept 19), not an alert. The campground's own boat ramp and road spur are 'permanently closed'.

Waterfront (stored lakeview) stands: site points sit ~100-150 m from the drawdown shoreline and ~80-100 m from the vegetated high-water edge, with willow thickets between; the FS says 'The hillside sites are about 100 yards from the high-water line. Willows separate campground from lake'.
